item.title: F1 races in Middle East to be cancelled because of war in Iran
item.summary: The Bahrain and Saudi Arabia Grands Prix scheduled for next month are set to be cancelled as a result of the Middle East war.

item.title: As hopes of regime change in Iran fade, Netanyahu faces political test
item.summary: Israeli leaders are framing the bombing campaign as having transformed the Middle East in their favour as pressure to end the conflict builds.

item.title: Dharshini David: The UK's economy was on shaky ground even before Iran war
item.summary: The government's hopes that 2026 would be the year when growth picks up are at risk of being scuppered.

item.title: All six crew members killed after US refuelling plane crashes in Iraq
item.summary: The US Central Command says all six crew members died after a refuelling aircraft went down over western Iraq.

item.title: 'I don't even think it was his message': Iranians on new supreme leader's first address
item.summary: People in Iran are questioning who's really in charge after Mojtaba Khamenei's first address came via a presenter on state TV.

item.title: Son of British couple jailed in Iran urges global leaders to help free them
item.summary: Lindsay and Craig Foreman were detained in January 2025 and later sentenced to 10 years in prison.

item.title: Husband who killed wife and buried her in the garden jailed for life
item.summary: Alireza Askari did everything in his power to cover up the "cold-blooded murder" of Paria Veisi.

item.title: Austrian glaciers disintegrating due to climate change, say scientists
item.summary: Scientists say nearly all of the significant glaciers in the Austrian Alps have shrunk.

item.title: Planters demoralised as council mows down 30k bulbs
item.summary: The city council is investigating after the bulbs were mowed over by staff days after being planted.

item.title: Why has Trump eased sanctions on Russian oil - and will it help Putin?
item.summary: The US said easing sanctions on Russian oil would provide only a limited financial boost to Putin.
